name: Lenskart Solutions Ltd.
business_summary: Vertically integrated eyewear company (design, manufacturing, retail, e-commerce) with ~2,800+ stores in India and abroad (Owndays in Japan, Singapore, Middle East). TTM sales Rs 10,383 cr (+41%), EBITDA margin 21-22%, PAT Rs 797 cr; market cap Rs 1.26 lakh cr at P/E 161, price Rs 725 (all-time high after Q2). Listed Nov 2025 (IPO price ~Rs 402, shares +80-90% since). Promoters 17.5%, FIIs 18%, DIIs 27%.

exposures.mechanism: Eyewear is a needs-plus-discretionary urban category (sunglasses, premium lenses, second pair). +5pp urban demand -> SSSG +3pp -> revenue +3% -> EBITDA +5% with 40% incremental margin on 22% margin = +5.5% EBITDA; EV/MCap 1.0, persistence 0.6 -> +3.3, plus growth-multiple effect -> +5.

evidence.note: Q2 revenue +36%, PAT 2.3x to Rs232 cr; international margin 10.6% on 29.5% growth; long-term 25% margin target; shares +11% to ATH (Entrackr, Inc42, Multibagg AI)
